name: How should I prepare my home before kitchen cabinet removal begins?

mainEntity.name: How should I prepare my home before kitchen cabinet removal begins?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before the crew arrives, you should completely empty every cabinet and drawer, clear off all countertops, and establish a clear path through the home to the exterior door. It is also wise to remove fragile wall decor from adjoining rooms, as vibration from removing fasteners can shake shared walls. If your base cabinets house a sink or dishwasher, verify whether your contractor will handle shut-offs or coordinate with a trade specialist to ensure water lines and electrical circuits are safely disconnected before tear-out starts.
acceptedAnswer.description: Empty all cabinet boxes and counters, clear pathways to the exit, and confirm that water and power supply lines are ready to be disconnected.
